claims: The final round of the 2026 Masters is on Sunday, April 12.
The final round of the 2026 Masters airs on CBS from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET.
Paramount+ streams early coverage from noon to 2 p.m. ET.
Players begin teeing off for the final round of the 2026 Masters at approximately 9:30 a.m. ET.
Featured Groups coverage is from 9:20 a.m. to 7 p.m. ET on Masters.com, Masters App, Paramount+, ESPN App.
Amen Corner coverage is from 11:15 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET on Masters.com, Masters App, Paramount+.
Holes 15 & 16 coverage is from 12:05 p.m. to 6:30 p.m. ET on Masters.com, Masters App, Paramount+.
